name: gateweave-mail
description: Gateweave Mail for an agent: verification codes, reading, sending with approval, addresses of its own and webhooks, over Mail's MCP server with an agent's key.

mcp_url.title: Mail's MCP server
mcp_url.description: Your Gateweave Mail's MCP address, such as https://mail.example.com/mcp, as Settings → Agents shows it.

mail_key.title: Agent key
mail_key.description: The key of an agent in your Mail workspace, from Settings → Agents. Claude Code keeps it with its own sign-in, not in settings.
